subject: Re: Weekend pressure test — temporary credit uplift & runbook
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Kate Miller <kate@edgecommerce.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Weekend pressure test — request for temporary credit uplift and runbook

Kate —

Quick note ahead of the weekend soak: EdgeCommerce's stress team flagged a 24h throughput + latency validation run starting Saturday 00:00 PT. The test includes multi-zone ramp, cold-start warmup, and a few long-tail concurrency spikes. To avoid throttling and preserve realistic telemetry we recommend a temporary credit uplift.

Proposal (short):
- Scope: 24 hours, global requests peaking ~18k rps synthetic traffic (your plan) with a sustained ~7k rps for 6 hours.
- Ask: +150,000 token-equivalent credits applied to the trial account for the window (covers requests and some buffer).
- Safeguards: automatic alert at 85% consumption; rollback to baseline at test end; telemetry dashboard + trace tags for the run.

I've attached a short runbook and a usage estimate. If procurement needs a PO/approval note, please loop them in — I cc'd your procurement alias in case. Monica, can you confirm on our side that we can approve a one-off promo uplift and hold billing while the run is limited to the documented window?

Attachments: poc-runbook.pdf (stub), usage-estimate.xlsx (stub)

Next step: if Kate confirms, we can apply the uplift today and lock the window.

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com

From: Kate Miller <kate@edgecommerce.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@edgecommerce.com>, procure@edgecommerce.com
Date: 2026-06-15T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekend pressure test — request for temporary credit uplift and runbook

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear plan. A couple quick clarifications before we greenlight from SRE/procurement:
1) Can you confirm the 150k number in credit terms (we track "credits" in our billing UI) versus tokens? We want a blunt conversion so finance can sign off.
2) Will the uplift be isolated to the trial project ID we shared (project: ec-edge-poc-2026) and prevented from being used by other test teams?
3) Can you add a line about rollback procedure if we see error-rate degradation >1% for more than 10 minutes?

Tom — copying you to confirm SRE readiness. Procurement, can you advise what you need to accept a limited promo (PO, email confirmation, or a simple SOW addendum)?

-Kate
Kate Miller
Head of Performance Engineering, EdgeCommerce
kate@edgecommerce.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Kate Miller <kate@edgecommerce.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekend pressure test — request for temporary credit uplift and runbook

Kate — good questions, thanks. Details below.

On 1) Conversion: 150,000 token-equivalent credits ≈ 150k generation tokens under the hosted API profile you’re using (gpt-small-like throughput). In billing UI terms that maps to a promotional credit of $1,200 for the uplift window (we've attached the usage-estimate.xlsx with the line items). If you prefer we can apply raw token credits instead of dollar promo; both are possible.

On 2) Isolation: we'll scope the uplift to the project id ec-edge-poc-2026 and tag all requests with the run_id header. No other projects will be able to draw from the uplift.

On 3) Rollback: we will implement automatic rollback to baseline if error rate >1% sustained for 10 minutes OR p95 latency exceeds 400ms for 3 consecutive 5-minute windows. We'll also maintain a canary at 5% traffic for the first 10 minutes of the primary ramp.

Monica/Ben — can we approve a promo credit hold for that project and set a billing hold so procurement isn't charged until EdgeCommerce signs off? I included the PO question from procurement so we know whether an email confirmation suffices.

Jordan

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Approval: temporary promo uplift for EdgeCommerce weekend run

Jordan/Ben —

I reviewed the runbook and the estimate. Approve one-off promo uplift scoped to project ec-edge-poc-2026: +150k token-equivalent credits, active 2026-06-19T00:00:00-07:00 to 2026-06-20T00:00:00-07:00. Conditions:
- Promo isolated to project and run_id.
- Billing hold active until EdgeCommerce acknowledges test completion.
- Auto-rollback triggers as Jordan defined.
- Telemetry tags and traces must be created in the runbook before start.

Ben, please attach authorization code and confirm we can apply the uplift in the console and enable the alert at 85% consumption.

Monica Patel
Director, Platform Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Kate Miller <kate@edgecommerce.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@edgecommerce.com>, procure@edgecommerce.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekend pressure test — temporary credit uplift & runbook (CONFIRMED)

Kate/Tom/Procurement —

All set: Monica approved the uplift and Ben confirmed the console changes. Promo applied to project ec-edge-poc-2026 as a scoped voucher: +150,000 token-equivalent credits (promo id: PROMO-EDGE-0626). Billing hold active; Redwood will not invoice for uplifted consumption during the window.

Operational notes:
- Run_id header: EDGE-WKND-0620 (please include in all test traffic)
- Dashboard: https://drive.redwood.com/s/edge-poc-runbook (live telemetry tab)
- Alerting: consumption alert at 85%, rollback triggers as documented.

Procurement — if you need this in a short SOW addendum we can generate a one-paragraph confirmation (you can reply-all with approval and we will attach to the deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/EDGE-8921).

Good luck with the run — we'll monitor from the ops channel and stand by for quick rollback if needed.

Cheers,
Jordan
